name: dsh-modpack-kit
description: Bundle several plugins into one .dshpack and install them in a single pass: full packs carry the payloads, lite packs record names and versions and fetch them from the registry, and both ship a standalone installer so a machine with nothing but a bare DSH can still install. Each plugin can be packed as upstream-basic or as your local copy. Packing always runs an in-memory scan for secrets and risky code (masked, never written to disk); high-risk hits pause the job until you confirm, and the confirmation is recorded in the manifest. Installing re-checks integrity, compatibility and licences, then re-applies the packed config, with options to install without enabling or to enable right away. Categories, search, sorting and entries come from the same plugin-market catalog (first screen lists only what you have, paged on the server), and the UI can be shown in settings, the sidebar or the plugins tab, each switchable. Installing the plugin market (dshmarket) first is recommended but not required.
author: Vesna-Strivozha-cn
